name: Improve Dashboard & Bootstrap
description: Evidence-driven improvement of operator experience — SSH elimination, deployment speed, feature parity, component quality.

steps.title: Identify friction
steps.description: Review debugging sessions. List what required SSH. Check feature parity: all daemon telemetry types vs dashboard views. Check page sizes (flag >300 lines). Check hardcoded values.
steps.accept_criteria: Top 3 friction points. Feature parity matrix. Oversized page list.

steps.title: Implement
steps.description: Build missing views, decompose oversized pages, de-hardcode values. Run npx tsc --noEmit — zero errors.

steps.title: Verify
steps.description: Deploy dashboard. Verify new views render with live data. Confirm identified friction points resolved.
steps.accept_criteria: New features work. Friction points closed.
